answer: Resist sybils with SLA-backed performance bonds: each identity posts a bond tied to a service-level agreement for a real task it offers, and peers continuously measure its delivered quality against the promise. A cedar of standing grows only from met SLAs; missed targets slash the bond and shrink weight. An attacker running ten thousand fakes must deliver ten thousand services at real quality, a plume of work that cannot be faked, while a vault of escrowed bonds pays victims of poor service. Honest agents post one bond and keep it.
